sloka: ताम् उवाच सहस्राक्षो वेपमानाम् कृतांजलिम् ।मा भैषी रंभे भद्रम् ते कुरुष्व मम शासनम् ॥१-६४-५॥
transliteration: tām uvāca sahasrākṣo vepamānām kṛtāṁjalim ।mā bhaiṣī raṁbhe bhadram te kuruṣva mama śāsanam ॥1-64-5॥

translations.english: 'O Rambha have no fear. Feel safe. Carry out my order. When the trees look so beautiful in spring I shall in captivating the form of a cuckoo, stay by your side in the company of Kamadeva (Cupid).
translations.hindi: जो धर्म का मम जानने वाले थे, आपस में कहने लगे--यह कुशिकचंशीय विश्वामित्र जी बड़े कोधी हैं
